༄༅/ /'khor lo bde mchog drag po chen po'i sgrub thabs mngon brjod bla ma las gsal bar gsungs pa bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /'khor lo bde mchog drag po chen po'i sgrub thabs mngon brjod bla ma las gsal bar gsungs pa bzhugs/

rab 'bar ye shes me lce yis/ /chos dbyings nam mkha'i mthas klas pa/ /rab gsal dkyil 'khor ri mo ni/ /ci yang 'char 'di ngo mtshar rmad/ /'dir dpal 'khor lo bde mchog drag po chen po'i sgrub thabs nyams su blang bar 'dod pas/ skyabs sems rdor sems bsgom bzlas spyi dang mthun/ rang gi snying khar ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐/ de'i 'od kyis bdag nyid he ru ka phyag gnyis par gyur/ 'od zer ba spu'i bu ga nas 'phros/ dpal bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor bla ma dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ skabs 'dir spro na/ rnal 'byor ma lha bcu gsum ma'i sgrub thabs su 'bri bar 'gyur ba ltar/ maṇ+ḍal gyi mchod pa rgyas pa bya/ bsdu na/ gang gi drin gyis sogs dang*/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro sogs kyis phyag 'tshal/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra bī ni hūm̐/ nas/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra dharme hūm̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra mahā su khaṃ/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi sogs/ rdo rje sems pa'i yi ge brgya ba lan gcig brjod/ tshad med bzhi spyi dang mthun/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ oṃ shū'u n+ya ta dz+nya na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las rang sems nā da nam mkhar gnas/ mtshams rngam dang bcas pa'i sum+bha lan gnyis brjod/ sngags las spros pa'i rdo rje'i sa gzhi dang*/ rwa ba dang*/ gur dang*/ bla re dang*/ mda'i dra ba ye shes kyi me 'bar ba dang bcas par gyur/ oṃ me dhi ni badz+ri sogs sngags chen drug brjod/ bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i dbus su yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po zla gam/ de'i stong du ram̐ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum/ de'i steng du bam̐ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po/ de'i steng du lam̐ las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi/ de'i steng du sum̐ las ri rab rin po che sna bzhi las grub pa/

de'i steng du pam̐ las sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte ba la/ hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje/ de'i steng du bh+rūm̐ dkar po las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal med khang*/ grub bzhi/ sgo bzhi/ rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ pha gu dang*/ bre phul dang*/ gser gyi snam bu dang*/ dra phyed dang*/ shar bu dang*/ mda' yab/ bzungs ma rnams dang bcas pa'i kha khyer te/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ sgo bzhi'i mdun du ka bas btegs pa'i rta babs kyis mdzes pa/ nang gi lha snam/ shar dkar/ byang ljang*/ nub dmar/ lho ser/ mtshams rnams su bum pa brgyad dang bcas pa/ dbus sngo ba'i steng du sku'i 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa mu khyud la 'khor lo'i 'phreng bas mtshan pa/ de'i lte bur gsung gi 'khor lo dmar po rtsibs brgyad pa mu khyud la pad+ma'i 'phreng bas mdzes pa/ de'i lte bar thugs gyi 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs brgyad pa mu khyud la rdo rje'i 'phreng bas bskor ba/ de'i lte bar pam̐ bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa/ sdong bu cung zad dang bcas pa/ gri gug gi 'phreng bas bskor ba/ steng thog rim par phug pa'i dbus phyur bur gyur pa/ nang gi lha'i gnas rnams su nyi ma'i gdan sum cu rtsa gsum mo/ /gzhal med khang gi phyi rol mchod pa'i bkod pa thams cad dang bcas shing*/ pad 'dab kyi 'khor yug bsrung ba'i 'khor lo dang bcas pa'i phyi rol dur khrod chen po brgyad/ phyogs bskyong ba dang*/ zhing skyong ba dang*/ shing dang*/ me dang*/ sprin dang*/ chu dang*/ ri dang*/ mchod rten dang*/ grub pa thob pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi yongs su khyab pa'o/ /bde chen 'khor lo'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor kyi steng du/ a āḥ nas/ aṃ aḥ phrag gnyis las zla ba/ de'i steng du ka kha nas/ ha k+ṣa/ ḍa dha/ da dha/ ya la phrag gnyis zhu ba las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de gnyis kyi bar du/

hūm̐ las rdo rje'i lte bar hūm̐ gi mtshan pa/ de las nam mkha'i nā da thim/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi don byas/ slar 'dus te hūm̐ la thim/ de thams cad yongs su gyur pa las/ lha thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa ni/ dbus su 'khor lo bde mchog che/ /drag po chen po he ru ka /sku mdog dus mtha'i sprin ltar gnag /mi bzad sna tshogs 'jigs pa'i sku/ /zhal dang phyag dang zhabs rnams ni/ /thams cad 'bum gyi grangs su bya/ /zhal ni ji rnyed thams cad kyang/ /mdun nag g.yon ljang rgyab dmar ba/ /g.yas pa ser por shes par bya/ /dang po rdo rje dril bus 'khyud/ /de 'og lha mo'i nu ma 'tshir/ /de 'og thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ bsnams/ /gnyis kyi glang lpags 'dzin pa'o/ /lcags kyu zhags pa dgra sta dang*/ /mdung rtse gsum pa mgo po nyid/ /cang te'u dang ni gri gug dang*/ /mda' dang gzhu yang bde bzhin ste/ /thod dbyug dang ni mdung thung dang*/ /sdigs mdzub dang ni gtun shing dang*/ /'khor lo ral gri rin chen dang*/ /pad+ma sna tshogs rdo rje dang*/ /rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dbyug to dang*/ /ga da mdung ring mdung kha leb/ /rdza ma be con chu gri dang*/ /dung dang rwa dung pa ṭa ha/ /pi wang gling bu rdza rnga che/ /rdza rnga rnga zlum gri gsum 'khyog /sa chu me dang rlung dkyil 'khor/ /sgra gcan keng rus 'jigs byed che/ /lus lag rkang pa lpags pa dang*/ /lcags sgrogs g.yas pa'i lha na ste/ /g.yon pa'i lhag ma'ang de bzhin no/ /de ltar phyag ni brgya phrag rnams/ /re re dang mtshungs stong phrag brgya/ / zhabs g.yas rnams kyis rim bzhin du/ /dus mtshan tshangs ma dbang mo dang*/ /dpal mo ga ga dbyangs can ma/ /gzhon nu ma dang drug ldan ma/ /re ba ti dang dga' byed ma/ /tsa mun ḍi dang klu ma dang*/ / gnod sbyin mo dang zla ba mo/ /nyi ma mo dang dga' ma dang*/ /tshogs bdag mo ni snying khar mnan/ / g.yon rnams 'jigs byed chen po dang*/

/tshangs pa dbang po nye dbang drag khyab 'jug kun 'gyed gzhon nu dang*/ /nag chen dga' byed dbang phyug dang*/ / gshin rje chu lha lus ngan dang*/ /zla ba nyi ma lus med dang*/ /tshogs bdag la sogs kha bub du/ /sgyel ba'i steng du rnam par mnon/ /lhag ma'i zhabs rnams thams cad kyis/ /bgegs rnams thams cad gnon te bzhugs/ /zhal thams cad rnam par 'gyur ma/ drag po chen po mche ba rnam par gtsigs pas 'jigs su rung ba/ gzhad pa/ mi sdug pa/ rab du 'jigs pa/ dpa' ba/ sgeg pa/ rngam pa/ smin ma rnam par g.yo ba/ snyems pa/ zhi ba/ g.yo ba/ mig g.yo ba/ zhal rnam par gdangs pa/ rnam par rol ba/ ljags rnam par bskyod pa/ sna tshogs pa'i nyams gtar par mdzad pa'o/ /sangs rgyas lngas dbu la brgyan pa/ rdo rje sems pas spyi bo'i gtsug tu brgyan byas pa/ rab du 'bar ba'i spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa'o/ /zhabs rnams g.yon bskums g.yas brkyang shing*/ ral ba'i thor tshugs dang*/ sna tshogs rdo rje dang zla ba phyed pa dang*/ thod pa skam po lnga lngas dbu brgyan pa/ phyag rgya drug dang mgo bo'i 'phreng ba can/ stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs grol ba/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ mtshan dpes spras pa'o/ /yum rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ g.yon thod pa khrag gi gang ba 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud cing*/ g.yas sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i rdo rje 'phyar ba/ byin pa gnyis kyis yab la 'khril ba/ skra grol zhing phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ thod skam gyi do shal can/ khrag la dgyes shing khrag 'dzag pa/ gnyis ka'ang bskal pa'i me lta bu'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /'dab ma brgyad la shar du mkha' 'gro ma nag mo ba glang gi gdong pa can/ byang du lā ma ljang khu rta'i gdong pa can/ nub tu dum skyes ma dmar mo glang po chen po'i gdong pa can/ lhor gzugs can ser mo ce spyang gi gdong pa can/ thams cad rtsa ba'i phyag gnyis kyi gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa'o/

/mtshams bzhir thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba rnams/ thugs kyi 'khor lo'i shar rtsibs su li ra ma la yar khaṇ+ḍa ka pa la dang*/ rab tu gdum mo nas/ byang shar ku lu ltar rdo rje sems pa dang rtson 'grus chen mo ste/ thams cad kyang sku mdog dkar po'o/ / zhes pa'i bar spyi dang 'dra/ thams cad kyang phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ 'jigs byed chen po rnams rnam par gnon pa/ yab rnams bcom ldan 'das mtshungs pa/ zhal phyag sna tshogs pa dang*/ yum rnams rdo rje phag mo dang mtshungs pa'i zhal phyag gnyis pa'o/ / sha ra sgor khwa gdong ma sngon mo/ /byang sgor 'ug gdong ma ljang khu/ nub skor khyi gdong ma dmar mo/ lho sgor phag gdong ma ser mo/ shar lhor gshin rje brtan ma g.yas sngo g.yon ser ba ma he'i gdong pa can/ lho nub tu gshin rje pho nya ma g.yas ser g.yon dmar ba bong bu'i gdong ba can/ nub byang du gshen rje mche ba ma g.yas dmar g.yon ljang ba rnga mong gi gdong pa can/ byang shar du gshin rje 'joms ma g.yas ljang g.yon sngo ba ra skyes kyi gdong pa can/ ma mo bcu gnyis po rnams ni/ rtsa ba'i phyag gnyis kyis/ ḍā ma ru dang thod pa bsnams pa/ mchan khung du kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang bcas pa/ dbu dang phyag dang zhabs dang mtha' yas pa ro'i gdan la g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis gnas pas dngos grub brtsol ba'o/ / bdag nyid kyi lus la rtsa 'khor lo bzhi/ yi ge dang bcas pa gsal btab/ zhal bzhi pa'i sngags brjod/ oṃ dharma dha tu badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ yum gyi snying khar oṃ ha dkar po nas/ phaṭa phaṭa dud kha tsaṇ+ḍi ka'i ngo bo/ /gnyis ka'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs khar hūm̐/ rang gi thugs kha'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis ye shes kyi 'khor lo spyan drangs/ phaiṃ/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ oṃ yo ga shud+dhaḥsarba dharmaḥyo ga shud+dho3haṃ/ slar yang 'od 'phros/ dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ phaiṃ/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/

/ zhes sogs kyis gsol ba btab pas/ / dbang bskur ba ni rdo rje che/ khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /gsang gsum gnas byung sbyin par bya/ /oṃ badz+ra u da ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ su ra ta s+t+waṃ ā haṃ/ zhes gsung zhing thod pa bdud rtsis gang bas dbang bskur/ dbang gi lha thams cad kyang bdag nyid la thim/ rig ma bcu drug gis mchod/ nang mchod byin gyis rlabs la/ rdo rje 'chang dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ /ka h+na ri mo na ro rin 'byung sbas/ /'jigs med 'byung gnas da sha ba la dang*/ / 'dren pa'i dpal dang shri gup+ta dang*/ /blo gros 'byung gnas dkar min sprin gyi zhabs/ /dz+nya na mi dra bde chen rdo rje dang*/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams la mchod pa 'bul/ / rtsa sngags kyi mthar 'bru gsum btags pas dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la phul/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra mahā su khaṃ/ zhes gsang ba'i mchod pa yang phul la/ yab yum gyi rkang pa brgyad pas bstod/ nag po pa ltar dag pa dran par bya'o/ /gal te drag po'i las la mos na/ 'khor thams cad kha dog mthing khar bsgom zhing*/ gtso bo'i zhal yang rtsa zhal khro bo'i zhal la/ zhal lhag ma rnams gdong brnyan du bsgyur te/ kha dang chu skyar gzhad dang ni/ /ce spyang skye gnyis sngags chen po/ khrung khrung ri skeg ka dam pa/ /zhes pa srog chags brgyad dang*/ bong bu dang*/ mi dang*/ rus sbal dang*/ khyi dang*/ rnga mong dang*/ rta la sogs pa/ phyugs sna tshogs pa'i gdong brnyan du bsgyur zhing*/ gzhan yang*/ rtsa ba'i phyag brgya phrag gcig dang*/ stong la sogs pa ji ltar mos pa de bzhin du bsgyur bar bya'o/ /bzlas pa'i dmigs pa ni spyi dang mtshungs zhing*/ bzlas bya ni/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru kaṃ ka ra ka ra ku ru ku ru nas/ dhi li dhi li hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ḍā ki ni dzā la sam+bha raṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ yab kyi snying po'o/ / oṃ badz+ra nā ra hi/ tad+ya tha pro taṃ gi ha na ha na

nas/ yo gi shwa ri phaṭa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ zhes pa'i bar yum gyi sngags sngags so/ /yab yum gyi rkang pa brgyad pa'i sngags kyang bzla bar bya'o/ /cher khros pas ha ha hi hi hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa ces kyang zlas so/ /thun bsdu bar 'dod na/ oṃ āḥhūṃ zhes dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs la mchod par bsam/ mtshams rngam dang bcas pa'i sum+bha lan gnyis su bzla/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad spros/ yang sum+bha tshar gcig bzlas pas bka' bgos/ de rnams kyi phyogs bcu'i bgegs rnams bkug /bsrung 'khor gyi phyir rol du brub khung du bcug pa la/ rang gi thugs kha nas spros pa'i phur bu rnams kyis btab/ oṃ gha gha sogs lan gsum brjod/ oṃ badz+ra mud ga ra sogs/ tho bas brdungs pas/ bgegs rnams ming yang med par byas par bsam/ slar yang dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs la gong bzhin mchod bstod byas la lha thams cad kyi rtsa ba'i phyag gnyis phur bu dang tho ba 'dzin par bsgyur te/ oṃ gha gha sogs kyi bzlas pa ci rigs par bya/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros/ snod bcud thams cad dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo 'od zer gyi rnam par zhu ste/ rang gi sna bug gnyis su zhugs/ snying kha'i hūm̐ la thim/ rang nyid kyang 'od gsal gyi ngang du zhugs/ phaṭa ces brjod/ slar yang stong pa'i ngang las lha skur gyur/ swāhā oṃ zhes brjod/ go cha gnyis kyi rgyas btab nas thun mtshams kyi bya ba la 'jug go /'di'i kha zas kyi rnal 'byor la/ kha zas thams cad ling gar byas te/ bskral nas bza' bo/ /gtor ma'i cho ga ni sdom 'byungagi mngon rtogs sushes par bya'o/ /bdud dpung phyed mar brlag byed cing*/ /grub pa brgyad sogs mngag bzhug dang*/ /mkha' 'gro ma dang srin po sogs/ /tshul 'di sgom pa'i bran du 'gyur/ /zhes pa drag po bdud 'joms pa zhes bya ba 'khor lo bde mchog drag po chen po'i sgrub thabs mngon brjod bla ma las gsal bar gsungs pa/

bla ma dam pa gang ba'i rdo rje'i zhal gyi man ngag bzhin/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā tha nam/ rdo rje ming gis mngon par mtshan pa dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i rnal 'byor pa lī la badz+ra gyis rang lo sum cu pa la gser mdog can gyi chos grwar sbyar ba'o/ /dge legs 'phel// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/'khor lo bde mchog drag po chen po'i sgrub thabs mngon brjod bla ma las gsal bar gsungs pa bzhugs/ - PAGE 376 -- PAGE 377 -- PAGE 374 -
